title: Do not let worry set the course
meaning: Directed effort can help your union when attention to detail prevents emotional guesses from becoming settled answers.
text: The overall tone of your union may be active within and restrained outside. In the physical position, the High Priestess suggests observing rather than rushing the first step while much remains unclear. In energy, the Chariot encourages you to choose a direction and carry a shared undertaking past obstacles. In emotions, the Moon describes unease before the unknown: imagination supplies missing details, so your sense of events can change before any new information arrives. This establishes neither accurate foresight nor another person’s hidden intention.

Suppose you are awaiting a reply to an application for premises that interest you. The paperwork is sent and the next step is understood, but the silence stretches. One evening it seems encouraging; another, it feels like an unexplained refusal. **Your direction is steadier when every wave of shared worry does not alter it.** Checking the stated response time calmly is more useful than cancelling everything because of an anxious guess or treating success as already settled.

The difficulty begins if action becomes a way to silence uncertainty. You want to call again, build fallback plans or argue over tones of voice, although the facts remain unchanged. Careful observation gives way to finding support for a story already imagined. Trying to regain control, you amplify each other’s speculation. It helps when shared anxiety can be named as anxiety rather than knowledge.
